description: The connected wallet, its X handle if linked, and everything it holds on every chain: the gas coin and each token, with the exact raw amount to use as sellAmount and a USD value where Warden can price it. A chain with no gas coin means: sell an ERC-20 with gasless=true where gaslessAvailable, or fund it first. Tokens under unrecognised were sent to the wallet unasked (not listed, not bought): never count them as money or suggest selling them unless the person names one. Where Solana is on, `solana` is the agent Solana wallet execute_swap trades from, and its holdings.
name: get_wallet
title: Connected wallet
